<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: light;
  overflow: hidden;
  --background: 210 50% 98%;
  --foreground: 235 9% 21%;
  --card: 0 0% 100%;
  --card-foreground: 235 9% 21%;
  --muted: 210 40% 96%;
  --muted-foreground: 218 10% 46%;
  --accent: 210 40% 95%;
  --accent-foreground: 235 9% 21%;
  --border: 212 26% 91%;
  --input: 212 26% 88%;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Ubuntu, sans-serif;
  background-color: #f6f9fc;
}
.login-background > div:first-child,
.login-content,
#footer {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}
.login-background > div:first-child button {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
}
.login-background::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: -10%;
  right: -10%;
  top: -42%;
  height: 78%;
  transform: skewY(-9deg);
  background: linear-gradient(150deg, {{accentColor}} 12%, #05d5ff 62%, #a6ffcb 96%);
}
.login-background::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: -10%;
  right: -10%;
  top: 30%;
  height: 48px;
  transform: skewY(-9deg);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 8%, color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 30%, transparent) 30%, transparent 55%);
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 460px;
}
.login-panel {
  padding: 40px 48px 12px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 50px 100px -20px rgba(50, 50, 93, 0.25), 0 30px 60px -30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}
.signin-methods > div {
  background: #f6f9fc;
  border: 1px solid #e3e8ee;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #414552;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 44px;
  border: 1px solid #e3e8ee;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: #ffffff;
  font-size: 15px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 25%, transparent);
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  color: #ffffff;
}
.login-form a {
  color: {{accentColor}};
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(50, 50, 93, 0.12), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07);
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: 0 7px 14px rgba(50, 50, 93, 0.12), 0 3px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
